adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#remove_member`, the diff shows `group.users.delete(user_id)` followed by `render json: success_json` if `group.save` succeeds. Using `delete` on an association removes join rows without instantiating/destroying join models, so any join-model `destroy` callbacks would be skipped (unlike the previous code path which called `group.remove(user)` in `update_patch`). Also, if the given `user_id` was not a member, `group.users.delete(user_id)` is a no-op and the action can still return success. This is a real behavior/semantics change, but the diff alone doesn’t prove it breaks correctness in this app (callbacks/expected error behavior aren’t shown).
